ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

3. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 44

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 22

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
